objective: Complete the approved unified DSH plugin, first D1/F1 foundations, then persistent PhotoCraft/DeckCraft and all remaining original50 tasks; direct running package only, no user desktop control
technicalRoute: Expose a bounded raw JSON request/reply method in the genuine Rust WASM control API; existing native source bytes and standalone APIs retain their formats.

Use an exact JSON integer codec, canonical uint64 identity checks and explicit {$u64: decimal} command-parameter atoms. Numeric-looking text stays text; unsafe already-rounded JS numbers are rejected.

Read native document/complete selection/page in one control drain; include a canonical native selection stamp in the execution fence. Do not flatten future raster masks or slide selection to Vector object arrays.
Make engine registration, selection and source extension explicit; only bridges that actually work are advertised as live.
Keep source revisions authoritative in NativeSourceStore; the project graph records explicit source/derivative/layout-instance relations without inferring links from names or hashes.
Verify F1 with genuine native placements and stored source/derivative/instance data before calling the foundation complete. Then wire Photo/Deck to the same identities, save barriers and graph.
